OpenSSL 3.5.8 is built from its unmodified official source archive by
`tools/build_tls.sh`. No device TLS binary is used. The archive SHA-256 is pinned
in that script; static libraries and generated headers stay in build-deps.

Source: https://github.com/openssl/openssl/releases/tag/openssl-3.5.8
